  function patchPlannerBody(old,hook) {

  async function patchBytes(input) {
    const bytes=input instanceof Uint8Array ? input : new Uint8Array(input);
    const profile=profileForSize(bytes.length);
    if(!profile)throw Object.assign(Error('Game module size changed. Native AI disabled.'),{patchCode:'module-size'});
    const hash=Array.from(new Uint8Array(await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256',bytes)),b=>b.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
    if(hash!==profile.hash)throw Object.assign(Error('Game module changed. Native AI disabled.'),{patchCode:'module-hash',moduleHash:hash});
    if(profile.transplant){
      // Fail closed. The exact original bytes were hashed just above; the transform pins its input and output again.
      const transplant=profile===P102C?TRANSPLANT_102C:profile===P609?TRANSPLANT_609:null;
      if(typeof transplant?.patchModule!=='function'||transplant.supports?.(hash)!==true||transplant.outputModuleHash!==profile.transplant.outputModuleHash)throw Error('Native patch set for this game build is unavailable.');
      return transplant.patchModule(bytes,{verifiedOriginalHash:hash});
    }
    if(profile!==LEGACY){const changed=patchCurrent(bytes,profile);if(!profile.ecuScope)return changed;const ecuPatcher=profile.revision==='ed8d3359'?ECU_PATCHER_ED8:profile.revision==='b1efa173'?ECU_PATCHER_B1:profile.revision==='bdc9cbc2'?ECU_PATCHER_BDC:ECU_PATCHER,ecuInput=profile.revision==='ed8d3359'?ECU_CHAIN_INPUT_ED8:profile.revision==='b1efa173'?ECU_CHAIN_INPUT_B1:profile.revision==='bdc9cbc2'?ECU_CHAIN_INPUT_BDC:ECU_CHAIN_INPUT;if(!ecuPatcher?.transform)throw Error('Verified ECU native scope patcher unavailable');return ecuPatcher.transform(changed,{inputSha256:ecuInput,originalModuleSha256:profile.hash});}
    const p={i:8};let output=null;
    while(p.i<bytes.length){
      const start=p.i,id=bytes[p.i++],size=read(bytes,p),bodyStart=p.i,end=bodyStart+size;
      if(end>bytes.length)throw Error('Invalid module section');
      if(id===10){
        const n=read(bytes,p),pieces=[bytes.subarray(bodyStart,p.i)];let changed=0;
        for(let i=0;i<n;i++){
          const sizeAt=p.i,bodyLen=read(bytes,p),fnStart=p.i,fnEnd=fnStart+bodyLen;
          if(fnEnd>end)throw Error('Invalid game function');
          if(i===BRAKING.index-37){
            const fn=patchBrakingBody(bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===CORNER.index-37){
            const fn=patchCornerBody(bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd));pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===TARGET){
            const old=bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd),a=locals(old),b=locals(BRIDGE);
            if(a.types.length!==31 || b.types.length!==64 || a.types.some((v,k)=>v!==b.types[k]) || old[old.length-1]!==11 || BRIDGE[BRIDGE.length-1]!==11)
              throw Error('Native AI hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(BRIDGE.subarray(0,BRIDGE.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));
            pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else if(i===PACE_TARGET){
            const old=bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd);
            if(locals(old).types.length!==1 || old[old.length-1]!==11 || PACE[PACE.length-1]!==11)
              throw Error('Native AI pace hook layout changed.');
            pieces.push(leb(PACE.length),PACE);changed++;
          }else if(i===WALL_TARGET){
            const old=bytes.subarray(fnStart,fnEnd),a=locals(old),b=locals(WALL);
            if(a.types.length!==1 || a.types[0]!==127 || b.types.length!==19 || b.types[0]!==127 || old[old.length-1]!==11 || WALL[WALL.length-1]!==11)
              throw Error('Wall contact hook layout changed.');
            const fn=join(WALL.subarray(0,WALL.length-1),old.subarray(a.end));
            pieces.push(leb(fn.length),fn);changed++;
          }else pieces.push(bytes.subarray(sizeAt,fnEnd));
          p.i=fnEnd;
        }
        if(changed!==5 || p.i!==end)throw Error('Native AI hooks were not found.');
        const section=join(...pieces);
        output=join(bytes.subarray(0,start),Uint8Array.of(10),leb(section.length),section,bytes.subarray(end));
        break;
      }
      p.i=end;
    }
    if(!output)throw Error('Native AI hook was not found.');

  }

  }

  function patchCurrent(bytes,profile) {

          }else if(profile.capabilities.nativeDriftRecovery && i===profile.driftRecovery.target){

          }else if(nos){

          }else if(profile.capabilities.nativeDragInputHandoff && i===profile.dragInputGuard.target){

          }else if(profile.capabilities.opponentDrag && i===profile.dragSelector.target){

          }else if(i===profile.target){

          }else if(profile.capabilities.pace && i===profile.pace.target){

  function compileLocal(input,options) {
    let source;
    if(ArrayBuffer.isView(input))source=new Uint8Array(input.buffer,input.byteOffset,input.byteLength);
    else {
      let size;
      try { size=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(ArrayBuffer.prototype,'byteLength').get.call(input); }
      catch { throw new TypeError('Explicit compilation requires an ArrayBuffer or typed buffer view.'); }
      source=new Uint8Array(input,0,size);
    }
    // Use a fresh intrinsic buffer, including for cross-realm buffers and subclasses.
    const copy=new Uint8Array(source.byteLength);copy.set(source);
    const bytes=copy.buffer;
    const nativeCompile=WebAssembly.compile;
    return prepareModule(async()=>bytes.slice(0),()=>nativeCompile.call(WebAssembly,bytes,options),nativeCompile,options,'explicit');
  }
  function install() {
    if(installed || typeof WebAssembly.compileStreaming!=='function')return;
    const nativeStreaming=WebAssembly.compileStreaming,nativeCompile=WebAssembly.compile;
    const streamingLoader=async function(source,options){
      const response=await source;
      let url;try{url=new URL(response.url);}catch{return nativeStreaming.call(WebAssembly,response,options);}
      if(url.origin!==location.origin || url.pathname!=='/game.wasm')return nativeStreaming.call(WebAssembly,response,options);
      return prepareModule(()=>response.clone().arrayBuffer(),()=>nativeStreaming.call(WebAssembly,response,options),nativeCompile,options,'streaming');
    };
    WebAssembly.compileStreaming=streamingLoader;
    installed=true;
  }

# Changelog

## 0.42.8 draft — synthetic near-miss requests and optional NOS top-up

Adds a manual synthetic near-miss control with exact module/session ownership, one outstanding request, signed observed deltas, event-specific confirmation and cancellation without automatic retries. Automatic NOS refill stays disabled. Source and native integration checks are separate from installation and live verification; historical flag receipts remain pinned to their original experiments.

Adds a session-only Keep NOS topped up switch using synthetic awards. It waits at full, resumes after consumption and allows one request at a time with a 250 ms confirmation cooldown. It accounts for active NOS elapsed time rather than treating raw stored credit as the live level. Unknown outcomes, ownership changes and style awards without positive observed NOS stop the loop. F7/F9 disarms it; focus and permission loss pause and cancel pending work. The retired direct refill API remains disabled.

The synthetic award has no speed threshold. Native command ownership is deferred until initialized driving state; switching cars withdraws an unclaimed request, and restarting a session cannot reuse the previous bridge. Native CPU and guest stack state are preserved around the original award call.

Fixes the offline attribution counterexample: a different consumed event cannot be acknowledged as the requested synthetic event. Recovery abandons an obsolete witness so a subsequent distinct request is usable. Lost native ownership produces an unverified outcome and closes that witness. Whole-tick NOS changes remain visible and are not attributed entirely to one near miss.

## 0.42.7 — automatic NOS refill disabled pending integration

Disables the extension's automatic NOS refill at the page and direct Engine API while near-miss integration is tested offline. The control remains unavailable even with saved selections, restored profiles or online permission. Normal game-earned NOS and native NOS use remain available. No production near-miss award generation is enabled.

## 0.42.6 — direct worker loading and scoped 60946132 support

Adds the exact reviewed game build **60946132**. Its scoped native port covers the existing AI bridge, pace/corner hooks, rails, Drag handoff/protection, owned skill and paired catch-up. Online still requires the separate explicit permission. Stop, manual takeover, stale ownership and permission withdrawal retain their native guards.

The production page now supplies a verified compiled module through its existing game-worker startup observer. It leaves WebAssembly.compileStreaming unchanged. Per-worker message order, immediate port transfers, original shared-memory identity and primary/secondary worker consistency are checked offline. A timed-out, unsupported or failed preparation retains the original game module with tools disabled. Memory-port startup stays unverified and has no page memory tools.

The replacement is authorized by freshly read build metadata, an import/export interface check and complete source/output hashes. An opaque original compiled module cannot be hashed through this interface; matching its import/export names is an eligibility check, not proof of its bytes. Only the independently compiled replacement receives a verified tool profile.

On 60946132, **the tuner, leased forward geometry, per-target corner feedback, online car-category controls, race capture and destination travel are unavailable** pending their separate ports. Their implementations and previous build profiles remain included. The full 102c8d92 pipeline retains its exact prior output.

Current game guards, monitoring and report serialization are retained. A positive encoder result means serialization succeeded, including for reports containing observations. The offline checks do not establish multiplayer acceptance, account status or measured driving results.

The offline report check reproduced a selected-car-state observation from the actual NOS refill: one changed frame and observation flag 16 in controlled race and free-roam monitor contexts. Untouched baselines had zero changed frames and zero flags. The observed fields survived local encoding; no report was sent. This uses bounded native fixtures and synthetic session state, not a full game run. A different loader does not establish a report-free refill route.

The exact captured page check returned zero marks through updated startup and four fixture ticks; the frozen 0.42.5 startup produced API-wrapper mark 2. The fixture uses native-callable browser stand-ins, clean settings and default tool selections. Worker instance postMessage remains wrapped and is not selected by that captured check. Report markers and configuration remain unchanged. These page results do not cancel the separate native NOS observation.

Raw 60946132 SHA256: 81d2e32d7ee67bb93a8fafee4dbc17570f8d4980be238d7434e15c791904b945.
Scoped native output SHA256: 8efc4457e895e4992f56a0272f66718d3900901ff7fde95e760b7585fa6f9129.

## 0.42.5 — exact native corner-target feedback

Adds observed native target decisions to the road-race settings and diagnostics on verified game build **102c8d92**. A sample records the actual target before and after the existing corner-limit hook, requested/effective limit, decision outcome, guard reasons, ownership and sample age. These are **uncalibrated native target units**, not mph or m/s.

- The menu can distinguish a geometry reduction, cached reduction, an already-lower native target, a rejected/unresolved guard and a changed publication. This observes the existing driver; it does not change pace, braking, steering, grip, shortcuts or race outcomes.
- Receipts use the game's existing worker registration channel under the site's current security policy. The extension consumes its reserved messages before the game registry sees them. Current primary and secondary workers are bound to their module, memory and session.
- Stop/manual takeover, setting changes, ownership/permission loss, stale samples and route changes clear current evidence. Tick and command-sequence boundaries reject queued records from a previous activation. Existing historical race logs migrate without losing their prior columns.
- The optional observer must match its complete expected binary hash and compile before it receives a capability. Any failure keeps the previously compiled driving, online, tuner and forward-lease module.

Native parity, receiver, loader, page and diagnostic tests passed offline. The actual current worker also delivered a native receipt in isolated Chrome under its current CSP. This is not a live race or a measured driving improvement. Transport samples at most once per 1,000 guest ticks; it is not a lossless record of every setter call.

**Other work remains isolated:** the opponent Drag margin for tracks 4211–4213 passed controlled native tests but needs a proven production control connection; the default-off Drift bend-target experiment sometimes lowers native throttle or increases handbrake and needs a live comparison; destination routing passed controlled topology/GPS checks but has unresolved native queue/allocation, route-installation and parking issues. None of those experiments is activated by this package. A complete hosted travel → join → race → return loop remains unverified.

Saved profiles, stream HUD, radar, Clean View, tuner, Street X limits, Drag engine protection, explicit online permission and Stop/manual takeover keep their existing implementations. The preset tuner remains restricted to solo Performance Tuning; this release does not enable an ECU bypass.

Raw game SHA256: `2ba0b075721d80e75fc3fb9a3b0e4d2acae835d21fcc406d009669b83f81858d`.
Observed native output SHA256: `6005ed0fe49b641542e9e2909cf38d10108959f2d2ed2ac74144866281ad8cfc`.

## 0.42.4 — clear rails and catch-up controls

This update fixes misleading assistance controls. It does not change the native driving, cornering, grip, power, shortcuts, tuning or network policy from 0.42.3.

- In a permitted rails road race or Street X, the assistance row says **Race pace · rails mode**. Catch-up strength is visibly inactive because paired grip/power assistance is not used there. Its selected value is retained for full physics and Drag.
- Switching rails off restores the strength control. Drag keeps its strength control and neutral paired pace. Recovery continues to show speed-only behavior, including when a stale physics sample still says rails is on.
- Messages, tooltips and accessible labels now distinguish pace targets from paired handling assistance. Online permission, Stop/manual takeover and saved driving preferences retain their existing behavior.

Validation: controlled page/mode regressions cover solo and online road races, Street X, Drag, recovery, permission changes, Stop and preserved settings. No live lap or measured grip/speed improvement is claimed. The existing nativeRoadTarget diagnostic is a sampled value in uncalibrated native units; it is not a per-setter explanation. A new per-setter receipt remains research and is not included.

The route-geometry and cache-lease changes from 0.42.3 remain unchanged. They still require the appropriate active AI, rails and Adaptive road-race speed settings for Circuit/Sprint/URL; live driving verification remains pending.

## 0.42.3 — route-based corner limits and rails diagnostics

Supports the verified game build **102c8d92**. This update targets intermittent road-race corner control while retaining the existing tuner, Runway 15 loop, saved profiles, streaming displays, Stop/manual takeover and online permission.

- **Corner limits:** enable **Adaptive road-race speed** with **Stay on rails** and an active owned AI driver for Circuit, Sprint and URL. Online also requires **Allow network tools**. The current-build route sampler now supplies a corner-speed limit even when native corner records are empty. Controlled tests cover sharp and gradual bends, including 75-degree and sharper turns; straight targets and lower native targets are preserved. The existing selected pace still applies. Adaptive remains session-only and starts off.
- **Sample renewal:** a validated corner limit can remain usable while the next route sample is captured. The native driver retains and rechecks its original route, ownership, permission and age constraints. Slow or missing sampling does not extend the limit's lifetime. Stop and context loss revoke the request. The new sampler does not operate in Drag, Drift, Street X, free roam, recovery or full physics.
- **Rails recovery:** pause, focus loss and stopped game frames no longer advance recovery timers. Losing the HUD or permission does not reset the same race's two-release allowance. This fixes a reproduced recovery defect; it does not explain every reported wall hit.
- **Diagnostics:** brief rails transitions are retained within existing log budgets. Corner plans survive the shorter sampling callbacks long enough to be logged. The export distinguishes a requested limit, a native cache acknowledgement, renewal and expiry; an acknowledgement is not a claim of continuous application or collision-free driving.

The optional native lease stage is enabled only after its exact output compiles. If it is absent or fails, the previously compiled driving and tuner module remains usable with this new geometry feature disabled. Current raw game hash: `2ba0b075721d80e75fc3fb9a3b0e4d2acae835d21fcc406d009669b83f81858d`. Lease-adapted output: `842f84cdac800f39a292b0d82c3182f4e225a3e1663541473bdc76f10528aae2`.

Validation is offline: controlled actual-native sampling and speed-setter execution, route and permission guards, page scheduling, loader fallbacks and mode-preservation checks. No live driven lap or complete hosted travel → JOIN → race → return has verified this release. These changes do not establish perfect cornering, improved race results or streaming autonomy. The tuner remains solo Performance Tuning only; the ECU clamp-bypass recipe is still unavailable on this build.

## 0.42.2 — race loop, preset tuner and mode corrections

Supports the verified game build **102c8d92**. Circuit, Sprint and Drag retain their existing driving requests and native paths. Saved profiles, streaming HUD layouts, Stop/manual takeover and explicit online permission are preserved.

- **Race loop:** adds the missing current-build hosted-lobby and race-start mappings. **Runway 15 only** selects the unique normal Runway 15 start, sets Wait here and disables general Drag discovery so the loop stays on that race. It waits for an open host and repeats after the game returns; an absent or ambiguous start is reported. Press Start selected loop after selecting it. In career free roam, enable Allow network tools, choose race locations or open Drag-lobby discovery, and press Start. The loop uses the existing travel, stationary wait, exact JOIN, race and return flow. A missing, stale, full, private or changed host cannot become a create-lobby request. Offline state-machine and native JOIN dispatch checks pass; a complete live trip still needs verification.
- **Street X:** the 1.15× rails ceiling now also applies when a saved Custom race pace is selected. With rails off and paired handling selected, both driver and handling request neutral 1.00× pace so their guards agree. The menu distinguishes the applied request from the saved selection. Street X rails/recovery parks conflicting legacy power/grip. Other race types retain their selected pace.
- **Drift:** parks saved legacy power/limiter overrides while the native Drift driver owns or releases the car. Native Drift steering, scoring and full-physics behavior are unchanged. This removes a conditional interference source; it is not a verified higher-score driving algorithm.
- **Free roam:** current-build contact preview now recognizes cars eligible for the enabled no-clip categories, instead of unnecessarily reducing pace for them. Native corner assist remains eligible during bounded city pace reductions for the same owned car and route. Walls and unproven contacts still count. Free roam retains full physics; this does not put the city driver on rails or establish perfect cornering.
- **Preset tuner:** restores Load settings, all 41 editable fields, private native Preview/search, Stage selected preset and Restore for the current build. Capture can initialize the native policy cache, avoiding a disabled-Load deadlock. Both verified memory windows retain bounds and committed-page checks; invalid snapshots still fail S42. The tuner requires the **solo Performance Tuning main screen**. Online tune writes and the separate ECU clamp-bypass recipe remain unavailable.

For tuning: enable the preset tuner, select the race preset in the game's solo Performance Tuning screen, Load settings, edit or Find tune, review Preview, then Stage selected preset. Use the game's Test Run to refresh driving physics and Save Profile to persist. Estimates are private native calculations, not measured lap times or confirmation of a disk save. Restore requires the same unchanged car, parts and preset.

The combined loader grants tuner capabilities only after both its native bridge and private evaluator compile. A failed optional tuner/city stage retains the last successfully compiled driving module. Current game metadata was rechecked before packaging. Unknown builds remain unsupported until independently verified.

Validation is offline: actual native snippets, private evaluator, controller/state-machine tests, actual-manifest compile/fallback tests and an isolated Chromium panel smoke check. No live race, live tuning session or complete hosted travel → JOIN → race → return was driven for this release. Three older UI/trace assertions also fail on the frozen 0.42.1 baseline; five additional historical tuner tests cannot run because their archived research fixture is absent. These limits are recorded in the workspace handoff rather than presented as passing.

Raw game SHA256: `2ba0b075721d80e75fc3fb9a3b0e4d2acae835d21fcc406d009669b83f81858d`. Combined online + city + tuner output: `3b11494b6824ced9888c5c4a9d3efc2ae86d75d0673544f0602d34a9bacabcfc`. Compared with 0.42.1, only native function 4653 (city corner eligibility) and function 21213's existing tuner prefix change.

## 0.42.1 — online native AI and car contacts

This update builds on the installed 0.42.0 package for exact game build 102c8d92. Enable **Online & diagnostics → Online / LAN opt-in → Allow network tools**, then select **Race-only automatic driver** for races or **Automatic driver** for free roam. Network permission starts off unless deliberately restored by a consent-bearing saved profile. F7 takes control; F9 stops tools and clears permission.

- Circuit, Sprint, URL and Street X can use Stay on rails online for the locally owned AI car. The existing 1.30× paired race pace and 1.15× Street X ceiling remain (Custom race pace still overrides Street X). Rails raises speed targets only; Catch-up strength does not supply grip on rails.
- Drag keeps its distinct opponent-driver/shift path and engine protection. Its paired handling boost uses neutral paired pace. Street X with rails off also uses neutral paired pace. Native catch-up inputs, generation/identity guards and explicit network permission still control application; no constant grip or winning claim is made.
- Skill-9 decisions work for the owned AI car online at the same seven reviewed decision sites. The player's saved skill marker is unchanged. The display is current eligibility, not a count of those decisions firing.
- Online car no-clip can select traffic, other players and NPC rivals, including verified current race and Outrun participants. The local contact filter, bounded rosters and per-category switches are retained. It does not change walls or props, and a local skipped contact does not prove a remote client skipped it.
- Current-build online free roam is recognized using the verified host tuple. Missing tuple memory makes this build unready instead of treating it as solo. Free roam keeps its existing native driver; the race rails pin is not enabled there.
- Recovery now counts rails releases across a driver rebuild, while resetting for an actual race/player/context change. It retains the existing two-release maximum. Diagnostics export rails request/current state, pin count, recovery state, online adapter/permission eligibility and skill-9 eligibility, with migration of prior logs.
- Online capabilities are granted only after the exact native online module compiles. Missing, wrong, throwing or invalid adapters retain the verified 0.42.0 solo module. Unsupported forward readers remain disabled rather than being advertised by the native transplant alone.

Offline native, controller, actual-manifest and page checks are recorded in the workspace handoff. These do not establish live online race results, server acceptance, cornering on every track or streaming autonomy. The broad older UI suite retains two pre-existing stale text/style assertions, reproduced on unchanged 0.42.0; behavioral checks pass.

The tuner/dyno/ECU panel, hosted travel/join loop and forward road reader are still unavailable on this exact game build. This update does not port those features. Saved profiles and HUD layouts are not rewritten.

Native pins: raw game SHA256 `2ba0b075721d80e75fc3fb9a3b0e4d2acae835d21fcc406d009669b83f81858d`; original 0.42 transplant `f113eb5dcd1292b6aac0e97837e653c9821b8a0a0efdfa221331d2fbf58fbe29`; adapted output `5bb985a5a7a77efabce919d7c3cd872c94466f3d66522449a106511413434fdf` (39,053,221 bytes). ## 0.42.0 — game build 102c8d92, and "Stay on rails" for cleaner corners

- New game build: nfsu2.xyz now serves build 102c8d92. 0.41.0 did not recognise it, so the native AI driver would not load. 0.42.0 adds an exact profile for it (module SHA-256 2ba0b075…, 38,867,137 bytes).
- How the port was made: the reviewed ed8d3359 hook set (bridge, pace, corner and braking targets, walls and car contacts, Drag, Drift, nitrous, forward preview, route choice, catch-up, paired pace, skill 9) was replayed onto the new build as one pinned transform, `native-transplant-102c.js`. Every changed function keeps all of the new build's own instructions in order; only authored instructions are inserted, with function, type and host-address references moved to the new build's values. Input and output are pinned by SHA-256 (output f113eb5d…, 39,052,721 bytes) and the result must pass WebAssembly validation, or nothing is changed.
- Rails: the game drives opponents on a simplified physics mode and flips a car to full physics after a contact. Your racer record made that flip permanent for your AI-driven car, which is where the wall hits at raised pace came from. **Stay on rails** (Race / outrun tuning, on by default) keeps your race AI car on the simplified mode in solo Circuit, Sprint, URL and Street X. It is a guard in Car::SetPhysicsMode that only acts for the car the extension's AI owns, in a solo road race, while the page asks for it.
- On rails, Race pace + catch-up raises speed targets only (Paired race pace slider, default 1.30×; Street X at most 1.15× unless Custom race pace is on). The paired power/grip boost is not used on rails because it is far too strong on simplified physics. Drag keeps the paired boost. Turning rails off restores the 0.41.0 behaviour.
- Stuck watchdog: if the car stays under 2 m/s for 3 seconds the rails release so normal physics can recover it, and return after 2 seconds above 20 m/s. At most two releases per race.
- Solo/offline only on this build: Allow network tools is disabled, and online no-clip, city pacing and the hosted race loop are unavailable. The site's own online free-roam check (three host cells, re-read from the new build) still pauses every tool.
- Not ported to this build: the preset tuner / dyno / ECU panel.
- Unchanged for older builds: every earlier exact build keeps its own files and behaviour (the ed8d3359 chain still produces 41470ae5…).
- Offline checks: the shipped transform reproduces the tested module byte for byte and rejects a wrong hash, changed bytes, the old build and an already patched module; the rails guard passed 75 fixture cases on the real lifted function; the loader and the page-side controllers ran in Node on both builds, and the panel script ran in headless Chromium against a local stand-in for the site whose worker models the bridge (it is not the game). Nothing was driven live. The 1.30× default comes from older logs of one track.

## 0.41.0 — best-opponent skill 9 for your AI car, panel fixes

- Skill: your racer keeps the game's player marker (254, read as −2) in its skill field, and the game's AI code clamps that marker to skill 0, the weakest level. The AI driver's GetSkill() (0x402580, the only caller of the skill getter) now answers 9 for that marker at the seven call sites that clamp it: nitrous delay and decisions (0x40844b, 0x40d863, 0x40d91e, 0x416faa), the Drag launch reaction delay (0x42c105), a per-skill decision chance (0x4082e6) and a manoeuvre parameter (0x42d666). The racer record and the save are not written.
- It applies only while the extension's native AI owns the local player's current car (mailbox magic, even and stable sequence, heartbeat under 180, mode 1–2, active code, in world, one local player, car on an AI driver that is the car's current driver), and never in a network session, with or without Allow network tools.
- Left exactly as the game has them: the off-screen reset check (0x402263), target-speed variance (0x41c648, 0x41c9c9; the marker already gets none, any skill 0–9 gets some), the catch-up curve and update (0x4085e6, 0x417382, 0x417591), the branch choice (0x413e3c, owned by the shortcut policy) and four sites that discard the result.
- The Driver line says "skill 9 for nitrous and race decisions" (Drag: "skill 9 for launch and nitrous decisions") while it applies. There is no switch; it follows the AI driver.
- Fixed: the panel, the popup and exported logs still showed version 0.38.18 after 0.39.0 and 0.40.0. They now show the installed version.
- Fixed: with the game's Catch Up off, the Race pace + catch-up line said "Game Catch Up is off · matching boost unavailable" although the 0.39.0 boost was working. That line now appears only on builds without the player-only catch-up patch. Drag and Street X report their own waiting/applied state, and online sessions say "Off in online sessions · solo races only".
- Correction to the 0.40.0 note below: the game's global mode at 0x8650B0 makes normal skills read as 9 and keeps the player marker. It was never a way to give the player's car skill 9.
- Offline checks: 353 fixture cases on the real lifted wrapper (each site, each guard, online, other skills; everything except the returned skill is identical to 0.40.0), one real consumer (0x408430) through the game's own virtual dispatch, and the full patch chain, whose output 41470ae5… validates and compiles. Exact ed8d3359 only. Live racing is unverified.

## 0.39.0 — player-only constant catch-up

- Race pace + catch-up now works with the game's Catch Up flag off and Mods: Rubberbanding set to Off or No boost. Before, its native publisher required Catch Up on and Rubberbanding = Original, so with those off your AI car never got any catch-up. New `godly-catchup.js` (exact ed8d3359 only, applied after the paced catch-up patch, pinned input/output hashes) makes those two checks pass in the 7 gated native functions (36 sites each, same-length edits). Opponents keep whatever the game setting gives them.
- With Rubberbanding off the game's own factor is 1, so your car gets a constant pace × strength handling/power factor for the whole race, whether it leads or trails. It never "waits" like game AI does when ahead.
- New defaults: paired race pace 1.00× (corner targets at the game's own speed, fewer wall hits) and catch-up strength 1.50× (a bit above the game's own skill-9 maximum of about +37–42%). Raise strength for more push; raising pace raises corner entry speed.
- Catch-up assistance is never enabled in online/LAN sessions, even with Allow network tools on.
- Drag, Drift and Street X are still excluded from paired catch-up. The JS readGain helper no longer checks the Catch Up flag or the (wrongly mapped on ed8) Rubberbanding host.
- Offline checks: the full extension patch chain reproduces the shipped 0.38.18 module exactly (92b567a3…), the new output (e40e7798…) validates and compiles. Live racing is unverified.

    }
    gripInfo(s) {
      if (!s?.ready || this.u32(A.FLOW)!==6 || this.u32(A.RACE)!==s.race || this.u32(this.u32(A.PLAYER)+4)!==s.car) return null;
      const physics=this.u32(s.car+0x34);
      if (!this.ok(physics,0x48)) return null;
      const wheels=[0x38,0x3c,0x40,0x44].map(o=>this.u32(physics+o));
      if (new Set(wheels).size!==4 || wheels.some(w=>w%4 || !this.ok(w,0x18c))) return null;
      const values=wheels.map(w=>this.view.getFloat32(w+0x188,true));
      if (values.some(v=>!Number.isFinite(v) || v<0.1 || v>4)) return null;
      return {physics,wheels,values};
    }
    gripOwned(s,patch,allowNetwork=true,driving=false) {
      return this.live(s,allowNetwork,driving) && s.car===patch.car && s.race===patch.race && this.u32(s.car+0x34)===patch.physics && patch.wheels.every((w,i)=>this.u32(patch.physics+0x38+i*4)===w);
    }
    restoreGrip(s) {
      const patch=this.gripPatch;this.gripPatch=null;
      if(!patch)return false;this.refresh();
      if(!this.gripRestorePending||this.gripRestorePending.car!==patch.car)this.gripRestorePending=patch;
      const guard=()=>this.gripOwned(s,patch);
      if(!guard())return false;
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
        if(!guard())return false;
        this.compareFloat(patch.wheels[i]+0x188,patch.expected[i],patch.original[i],guard);
      }
      return true;
    }
    legacyPhysicsNeutral(s) {
      if(this.performancePatch||this.gripPatch||!s?.ready||!this.live(s,true))return false;
      this.refresh();
      const power=this.performanceRestorePending,grip=this.gripRestorePending;
      if(power){
        const info=this.performanceInfo(s);
        if(!info)return false;
        if(power.car!==s.car||power.pi!==info.pi||power.ride!==info.ride)this.performanceRestorePending=null;
        else if(info.values.length===power.original.length&&info.values.every((v,i)=>v===power.original[i]))this.performanceRestorePending=null;
        else return false;
      }
      if(grip){
        const info=this.gripInfo(s);
        if(!info)return false;
        if(grip.car!==s.car||grip.physics!==info.physics||grip.wheels.some((w,i)=>w!==info.wheels[i]))this.gripRestorePending=null;
        else if(info.values.every((v,i)=>v===grip.original[i]))this.gripRestorePending=null;
        else return false;
      }
      return true;
    }
    tuneGrip(s, factor=1, allowNetwork=false) {
      this.refresh();
      if(!this.live(s,allowNetwork,true)||!Number.isFinite(factor)||factor<1||factor>2){this.restoreGrip(s);return {ok:false};}
      if(this.u32(0x890104)!==0||this.u8(0x89e7d9)!==0||(!this.u8(0x89e7d8)&&!this.u32(0x890108)&&this.u32(0x890114)!==0)){this.restoreGrip(s);return {ok:false,paused:true,reason:'Extra grip is paused during drift mode/races.'};}
      if(factor===1){this.restoreGrip(s);return {ok:true,active:false};}
      const info=this.gripInfo(s);
      if(!info){this.restoreGrip(s);return {ok:false,reason:'Wheel physics unavailable.'};}
      let patch=this.gripPatch;
      if(patch&&(patch.car!==s.car||patch.race!==s.race||patch.physics!==info.physics||patch.wheels.some((w,i)=>w!==info.wheels[i]))){this.gripPatch=null;patch=null;}
      if(patch&&info.values.some((v,i)=>v!==patch.expected[i])){this.restoreGrip(s);return {ok:false,changed:true,reason:'Wheel physics changed. Extra grip will resume after the new values settle.'};}
      if(!patch)patch={car:s.car,race:s.race,physics:info.physics,wheels:info.wheels,original:info.values,expected:info.values.slice()};
      const expected=patch.original.map(v=>Math.fround(Math.min(4,v*factor)));
      const guard=()=>this.gripOwned(s,patch,allowNetwork,true)&&this.u32(0x890104)===0&&this.u8(0x89e7d9)===0&&(this.u8(0x89e7d8)!==0||this.u32(0x890108)!==0||this.u32(0x890114)===0);
      this.gripPatch=patch;
      for(let i=0;i<4;i++){
        if(!this.compareFloat(info.wheels[i]+0x188,patch.expected[i],expected[i],guard)){
          this.restoreGrip(s);return {ok:false,changed:true,reason:'Car state changed during grip adjustment. Waiting for stable values.'};
        }
        patch.expected[i]=expected[i];
      }
      return {ok:true,active:true,factor};
    }
    driftTap(ptr) {
      // Same synthetic action used by the game's touch Drift button, through
      // its documented single-producer main-page input ring instead of hidden DOM.
      this.refresh();
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(ptr) || ptr <= 0 || ptr % 4 || ptr+20800 > this.view.byteLength) return false;
      const h=new Int32Array(this.view.buffer,ptr,64);
      if ((Atomics.load(h,0)>>>0)!==0x4e494e50 || Atomics.load(h,1)!==2 || Atomics.load(h,3)!==1024 || Atomics.load(h,7)!==1 || Atomics.load(h,27)!==0 || Atomics.load(h,34)!==0) return false;
      const w=Atomics.load(h,4), r=Atomics.load(h,5);
      if (((w-r)>>>0)>=1024) return false;
      const p=ptr+4416+(w&1023)*16;
      const bytes=new Uint8Array(this.view.buffer,p,16); bytes.fill(0);
      bytes[0]=3; bytes[1]=0xf1; bytes[3]=32; // KEY_TAP, dedicated Drift key, synthetic.
      Atomics.store(h,4,(w+1)|0); Atomics.notify(h,4,1);
      return true;
    }
    hazards(s) {
      // Read-only tester. These are cars and the track's barrier-line table,
      // not a complete collision mesh, traffic classifier, lane map or autopilot.
      if (!s.ready) return null;
      const f = p => this.ok(p) ? this.view.getFloat32(p, true) : NaN;
      const x = f(s.car + 0x60), y = f(s.car + 0x64), z = f(s.car + 0x68);
      let fx = f(s.car + 0x90), fy = f(s.car + 0x94);
      const fl = Math.hypot(fx, fy);
      if (![x,y,z,fl].every(Number.isFinite) || fl < 0.5 || fl > 1.5) return null;
      fx /= fl; fy /= fl;
      const world = this.u32(0x890080), seen = new Set(); let car = this.u32(world);
      const cars = [];
      while (car && car !== world && seen.size < 96 && this.ok(car, 0x9e4) && !seen.has(car)) {
        seen.add(car);
        if (car !== s.car) {
          const dx = f(car + 0x60) - x, dy = f(car + 0x64) - y, dz = f(car + 0x68) - z;
          const ahead = dx * fx + dy * fy, side = -dx * fy + dy * fx;
          if ([ahead,side,dz].every(Number.isFinite) && ahead > 0 && ahead < 150 && Math.abs(side) < 20 && Math.abs(dz) < 5)
            cars.push({ ahead, side, car, body:this.u32(car+0x3c) });
        }
        car = this.u32(car);
      }
      cars.sort((a,b) => a.ahead - b.ahead);
      const nb = this.u32(0x88f298 + 0x498), bars = this.u32(0x88f298 + 0x49c);
      let barrierAhead = null, activeBarriers = 0;
      if (nb <= 8192 && this.ok(bars, nb * 0x24)) for (let i = 0; i < nb; i++) {
        const p = bars + i * 0x24; if (!this.u8(p + 0x10)) continue;
        const ax = f(p) - x, ay = f(p+4) - y, bx = f(p+8) - x, by = f(p+12) - y;
        if (![ax,ay,bx,by].every(Number.isFinite)) continue;
        activeBarriers++;
        const al = -ax*fy + ay*fx, bl = -bx*fy + by*fx;
        if ((al > 0) === (bl > 0) || Math.abs(al-bl) < 0.0001) continue;
        const t = al / (al-bl), distance = (ax + (bx-ax)*t)*fx + (ay + (by-ay)*t)*fy;
        if (distance >= 0 && distance < 150 && (barrierAhead === null || distance < barrierAhead)) barrierAhead = distance;
      }
      return { cars, scannedCars: seen.size, activeBarriers, barrierAhead };
    }
    pacingHazards(s, exactProfile=false, allowNetwork=false) {
      this.refresh();
      if(!exactProfile||!this.live(s,allowNetwork,true)||this.u32(s.car+0x24)!==3)return null;
      const player=this.u32(A.PLAYER),driver=this.u32(s.car+0x2c),world=this.u32(0x890080),bars=this.u32(0x88f734),count=this.u32(0x88f730),track=this.u32(0x89e7a0);
      if(!this.ok(driver,0x800)||this.u32(driver)!==0x785370||this.u32(driver+4)!==s.car)return null;
      // Reuse the established read-only reader. Recheck its source identities
      // before submitting any reduction; an absent scan is never a clear road.
      const sample=this.hazards(s);
      if(!this.live(s,allowNetwork,true)||this.u32(A.PLAYER)!==player||this.u32(s.car+0x24)!==3||this.u32(s.car+0x2c)!==driver||this.u32(driver+4)!==s.car||this.u32(0x890080)!==world||this.u32(0x88f734)!==bars||this.u32(0x88f730)!==count||this.u32(0x89e7a0)!==track)return null;
      return sample;
    }
    nosDiagnostics(s, exactProfile = false) {
      // Read before refill, so the export can show resource/timing state that
      // the refill would otherwise mask. These are sampled raw state fields,
      // not native activation/stop counters or proof of a successful burst.
      this.refresh();
      if (!exactProfile || !s?.ready || !this.live(s)) return {};
      const networkClock=this.nosNetworkClock(),clock=this.u32(networkClock?A.NETWORK_TICKS:A.TICKS);
      const since=this.u32(s.car+A.NOS_SINCE),full=this.u32(s.car+A.NOS_FULL),remaining=this.u32(s.car+A.NOS_LEFT);
      const active=since!==0&&since!==0x7fffffff;
      const out={nosTelemetry:true,nosClockNetwork:networkClock,nosClockTicks:clock,nosSinceTicks:since,nosTimestampActive:active};
      if(full<10000000)out.nosFullTicks=full;
      if(remaining<10000000)out.nosRemainingTicks=remaining;
      if(active)out.nosElapsedTicks=(clock|0)-(since|0);
      if(!this.live(s)||this.nosNetworkClock()!==networkClock||this.u32(s.car+A.NOS_FULL)!==full||this.u32(s.car+A.NOS_SINCE)!==since)return {};
      return out;
    }
    dragEngineDiagnostics(s, exactProfile = false) {
      this.refresh();
      if (!exactProfile || !s?.ready || !this.live(s) || !this.u8(A.DRAG) || this.u32(s.car+0x28)!==1) return {};
      const physics=this.u32(s.car+0x34);
      if (physics%4 || !this.ok(physics,0x4c)) return {};
      const motor=this.u32(physics+0x48);
      if (motor%4 || !this.ok(motor,0x90)) return {};
      const heat=this.view.getFloat32(motor+0x8c,true),out={};
      if (Number.isFinite(heat) && heat>=-1 && heat<=2) {out.dragEngineHeat=heat;out.dragHeatDisabled=heat<0;out.dragEngineBlown=heat===2;}
      const params=this.u32(motor+0x18);
      if (params%4===0 && this.ok(params,8)) {
        const limit=this.view.getFloat32(params+4,true);
        if (Number.isFinite(limit) && limit>=1000 && limit<=30000) out.dragEngineLimitRpm=limit;
      }
      return out;
    }
    driftDiagnostics(s, exactProfile = false) { return this.nativeDiagnostics(s, exactProfile, true); }
    nativeDiagnostics(s, exactProfile = false, driftOnly = false, withStatus = false) {
      // Read-only, best-effort scalar samples. The page opts in only after the
      // exact reviewed module profile has been verified. Never export pointers.
      this.refresh();
      // The logger opts into fixed failures; older optional readers retain
      // their empty-sample contract. Neither path writes native state.
      const unavailable=code=>withStatus?{nativeTelemetry:false,nativeTelemetryStatus:code}:{};
      if (!exactProfile) return unavailable('profile-unverified');
      if (!s?.ready) return unavailable('state-unavailable');
      if (!this.live(s)) return unavailable('context-stale');
      const car=s.car, race=s.race, d=this.view;
      const f=(p,lo,hi)=>{if(!this.ok(p))return undefined;const v=d.getFloat32(p,true);return Number.isFinite(v)&&v>=lo&&v<=hi?v:undefined;};
      // Same event inputs as the reviewed native corner/Street X guards:
      // RaceParams+0x43, forced Street X, and the separate network mode enum.
      const network=()=>this.networkState();
      const networkSample=network(),networkMode=this.u32(0x850088);
      const out={nativeTelemetry:true,nativeTelemetryStatus:'sampled',trackId:this.u32(0x89e7a0),dragRace:!!this.u8(0x89e7d8),forcedDrag:!!this.u32(0x890108),driftRace:!!this.u8(0x89e7d9),forcedDrift:!!this.u32(0x890104),driftVariant:!!this.u32(0x890114),streetXRace:!!this.u8(0x89e7e3),forcedStreetX:!!this.u32(0x89010c),onlineStreetX:networkSample&&networkMode===10,nativeRoadTargetStatus:'driver-unverified'};
      const driftFamily=(out.driftRace||out.forcedDrift||out.driftVariant)&&!out.dragRace&&!out.forcedDrag;
      if(driftOnly&&!driftFamily)return unavailable('drift-ineligible');
      out.carRpm=s.rpm;out.carGear=s.gear;
      const player=this.u32(A.PLAYER);
      if(this.ok(player,0x234)){
        const input=this.u32(player+0x22c),next=this.u32(player+0x230);
        if(input<=10)out.nativeInputMode=input;if(next<=10)out.nativeNextInputMode=next;
      }
      const put=(k,v)=>{if(v!==undefined)out[k]=v;};
      put('speedMps',f(car+0x430,0,500));put('forwardMps',f(car+0x42c,-500,500));
      const record=this.u32(car+0x14);
      if(this.ok(record,0x902)&&this.u32(record+4)===1)out.nativeSkill=this.u8(record+0x901);
      const driver=this.u32(car+0x2c),driverKind=this.u32(car+0x24),driverOK=driverKind===3&&this.ok(driver,0x800)&&this.u32(driver)===0x785370&&this.u32(driver+4)===car;
      out.aiDriverVerified=!!driverOK;
      let behavior=0,action=0,behaviorVT=0,behaviorVerified=false,actionVT=0,actionId=0,actionReadable=false,navigation=0,config=0,companion=0;
      if(driverOK){
        out.nativeRoadTargetStatus='behavior-unverified';
        put('nativePaceFactor',f(driver+0x770,0,4));
        behavior=this.u32(driver+8);action=this.u32(driver+0x6fc);
        navigation=this.u32(driver+0xc);config=this.u32(driver+0x6e0);companion=this.u32(driver+0x6f8);
        out.nativeNavigationPresent=navigation!==0;out.nativeNavigationValid=this.ok(navigation,0x30);
        out.nativeConfigPresent=config!==0;out.nativeConfigValid=this.ok(config,4);
        out.nativeCompanionPresent=companion!==0;out.nativeCompanionValid=this.ok(companion,0x200);
        out.aiGoalPending=action===0;
        out.aiGoalRecognized=false;
        if(this.ok(action,24)){
          actionId=this.u32(action+20);actionVT=this.u32(action);actionReadable=true;
          const tables={1:0x784768,2:0x7847d0,3:0x784830,5:0x784b58,7:0x7848a0,8:0x784900,11:0x784968};
          if(tables[actionId]&&actionVT===tables[actionId]){out.aiGoalId=actionId;out.aiGoalRecognized=true;}
        }
        if(behavior%4===0&&this.ok(behavior,0x234)&&this.u32(behavior+0x220)===car){
          behaviorVT=this.u32(behavior);behaviorVerified=true;out.nativeDriftBehavior=behaviorVT===0x784f40;out.nativeRoadBehavior=behaviorVT===0x784eb0;
          // Exact AA setter f6140 (guest0x4054a0) stores the first target
          // argument at behavior+0x230. Its sign is preserved. Native units
          // have not been calibrated against displayed speed or metricScale.
          if(out.nativeRoadBehavior){const target=f(behavior+0x230,-500,500);put('nativeRoadTarget',target);out.nativeRoadTargetStatus=target===undefined?'value-invalid':'sampled';}
          else out.nativeRoadTargetStatus='not-road';
          if(out.nativeDriftBehavior&&driftFamily)put('driftTargetMps',f(behavior+0x22c,-200,200));
          if(out.nativeDriftBehavior||out.nativeRoadBehavior){
            put('nativeThrottle',f(behavior+0x20c,0,1));put('nativeHandbrake',f(behavior+0x210,0,1));put('nativeBrake',f(behavior+0x214,0,1));
            out.nativeSteering=d.getInt16(behavior+0x1e0,true);
            const gear=d.getInt32(behavior+0x1e4,true);if(gear>=-1&&gear<=10)out.nativeGearCommand=gear;
          }
          if(out.nativeRoadBehavior&&this.ok(behavior,0x264)&&this.ok(car+0x390,4)){
            // Native421f45..421fc7 can latch +25c after59fa30(car+40),
            // then use +22c for throttle and clear brake while the requested
            // target is at least the previous target stored at +260. These are sampled
            // inputs/state, not proof that this override ran in this frame.
            const latched=this.u8(behavior+0x25c);if(latched<=1)out.nativeControlOverrideLatched=!!latched;
            put('nativePreviousTarget',f(behavior+0x260,-500,500));put('nativeThrottleHold',f(behavior+0x22c,0,1));
            // Native4210e0..421105 additionally queries592870 per flagged
            // wheel. This mask reports only the four nonzero source bytes.
            out.nativeWheelContactMask=[0,1,2,3].reduce((mask,i)=>mask|(this.u8(car+0x390+i)?1<<i:0),0);
          }
        }
      }
      const racer=this.u32(car+0x1c),count=this.u32(race+0x24);
      let score=0,driftCar=0,style=0,racerSlot=-1;
      if(count>=1&&count<=6)racerSlot=Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>this.u32(race+0xbd0+i*4)).indexOf(racer);
      if(driftFamily)out.driftScoreLinked=false;
      if(driftFamily&&this.ok(racer,0x1f0)&&this.u32(racer)===car&&racerSlot>=0){
        score=this.u32(racer+0x1d4);driftCar=this.u32(racer+0x1d8);
        if(this.ok(score,39*4)&&this.ok(driftCar,0x48)&&this.u32(driftCar)===score&&this.u32(driftCar+4)===racer&&this.u32(driftCar+8)===car){
          style=this.u32(score);
          if(this.ok(style,0x3c)&&this.u32(style+0xc)===0){
            out.driftScoreLinked=true;
            const state=this.u32(style+0x14),level=this.u32(driftCar+0x1c),next=this.u32(driftCar+0x20);
            if(state<=4)out.driftScoreState=state;
            if(level>=1&&level<=5)out.driftMultiplier=level;
            if(next<=1e9)out.driftNextPoints=next;
            put('driftPendingPoints',f(style+0x24,0,1e9));put('driftBankedPoints',f(style+0x2c,0,1e9));put('driftRawRate',f(driftCar+0x34,0,1e6));
            put('driftLatchedSlipRad',f(driftCar+0x44,-Math.PI,Math.PI));
            put('currentRawRouteProgress',f(racer+0x14,-1,1e7));put('driftBestRawRouteProgress',f(driftCar+0x30,-1,1e7));
            out.driftCollisionLoss=!!this.u8(driftCar+0x15);
          }
        }
      }
      // Identity may change while the native game is running. Reject a sample
      // if the validated graph changed; this is not a native frame lock.
      if(!this.live(s)||this.u32(car+0x14)!==record||this.u32(car+0x2c)!==driver||this.u32(car+0x24)!==driverKind)return unavailable('context-changed');
      if(this.u32(0x89e7a0)!==out.trackId||!!this.u8(0x89e7d9)!==out.driftRace||!!this.u32(0x890104)!==out.forcedDrift||!!this.u32(0x890114)!==out.driftVariant||!!this.u8(0x89e7d8)!==out.dragRace||!!this.u32(0x890108)!==out.forcedDrag||!!this.u8(0x89e7e3)!==out.streetXRace||!!this.u32(0x89010c)!==out.forcedStreetX||network()!==networkSample||this.u32(0x850088)!==networkMode)return unavailable('context-changed');
      if(this.u32(A.PLAYER)!==player)return unavailable('context-changed');
      if(out.nativeInputMode!==undefined&&this.u32(player+0x22c)!==out.nativeInputMode)return unavailable('context-changed');
      if(out.nativeNextInputMode!==undefined&&this.u32(player+0x230)!==out.nativeNextInputMode)return unavailable('context-changed');
      if(out.nativeSkill!==undefined&&this.u32(record+4)!==1)return unavailable('context-changed');
      if(driverOK&&(this.u32(driver)!==0x785370||this.u32(driver+4)!==car||this.u32(driver+8)!==behavior||this.u32(driver+0x6fc)!==action||this.u32(driver+0xc)!==navigation||this.u32(driver+0x6e0)!==config||this.u32(driver+0x6f8)!==companion))return unavailable('context-changed');
      if(behaviorVerified&&(this.u32(behavior)!==behaviorVT||this.u32(behavior+0x220)!==car))return unavailable('context-changed');
      if(actionReadable&&(this.u32(action)!==actionVT||this.u32(action+20)!==actionId))return unavailable('context-changed');
      if(out.driftScoreLinked&&(this.u32(car+0x1c)!==racer||this.u32(racer)!==car||this.u32(race+0x24)!==count||this.u32(race+0xbd0+racerSlot*4)!==racer||this.u32(racer+0x1d4)!==score||this.u32(racer+0x1d8)!==driftCar||this.u32(score)!==style||this.u32(style+0xc)!==0||this.u32(driftCar)!==score||this.u32(driftCar+4)!==racer||this.u32(driftCar+8)!==car))return unavailable('context-changed');
      return out;
    }
    status(ptr) {
      this.refresh();
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(ptr) || ptr <= 0 || ptr % 4 || ptr + 16 > this.view.byteLength) return null;
      const h = new Int32Array(this.view.buffer, ptr, 4);
      if ((Atomics.load(h, 0) >>> 0) !== 0x31545453) return null;
      const seq = Atomics.load(h, 1), count = Atomics.load(h, 2);
      if (seq & 1 || count < 0 || count > this.statusCapacity || ptr + 16 + count * 24 > this.view.byteLength) return null;
      const out = {};
      for (let k = 0; k < count; k++) {
        const p = ptr + 16 + 24 * k; let name = '';
        for (let j = 0; j < 16; j++) { const c = this.view.getUint8(p + j); if (!c) break; name += String.fromCharCode(c); }
        out[name] = this.view.getFloat64(p + 16, true);
      }
      return seq === Atomics.load(h, 1) ? out : null;
    }
  }
  class StableGate {
    constructor(samples=3) {this.samples=samples;this.reset();}
    reset() {this.last=null;this.count=0;}
    accept(value) {const key=JSON.stringify(value);if(key!==this.last){this.last=key;this.count=1;}else this.count++;return this.count>=this.samples;}
  }
  function adaptiveRaceSettings({enabled=false,ceiling=1.3,verified=false,ai=false,safe=false,network=false,allowNetwork=false,hud=0,raceType=-1,drag=false,drift=false,streetX=false}={}) {
    // Session-only orchestration of the existing distance-based native route
    // envelope. This is not a per-frame multiplier, steering or NOS controller.
    const result=state=>({requested:state==='requested',state,ceiling});
    if(enabled!==true)return result('off');
    if(!Number.isFinite(ceiling)||ceiling<1||ceiling>2)return result('invalid');
    if(verified!==true)return result('unsupported');
    if(streetX)return result('street-x');

  const read = (value, key) => { try { return value == null ? undefined : value[key]; } catch { return undefined; } };
  const str = value => typeof value === 'string' ? value.slice(0,MAX_ERROR_INPUT) : '';
  const number = (value, limits) => typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= limits[0] && value <= limits[1] ? Math.round(value*1000)/1000 : undefined;
  function fields(value, flags, numbers) {
    const out = {};
    for (const key of flags) if (typeof read(value,key) === 'boolean') out[key] = read(value,key);
    for (const [key,limits] of Object.entries(numbers)) { const v = number(read(value,key),limits); if (v !== undefined) out[key] = v; }
    return out;
  }
  const MAX_RAILS_TRANSITIONS=24;
  const RAILS_TRANSITION_FLAGS=['railsSelected','supported','ready','network','safe','hidden','focused','menuOpen','onlineAIAllowed','railsWanted','railsRequested','railsOn','railsSuspended','aiActive','aiOwned','handbackPending'];
  const RAILS_TRANSITION_NUMBERS={hud:[0,3],raceType:[0,100],racePhase:[0,100],driverKind:[0,100],physicsKind:[0,100],railsRecoveryTrips:[0,2]};
  const RAILS_TRANSITION_REASONS=new Set(['selection-off','build-unavailable','state-unavailable','tab-hidden','window-unfocused','game-menu','network-permission','mode-ineligible','not-driving','recovery-release','recovery-limit','handback-pending','simplified-physics-observed','owned-full-physics-observed','ownership-pending','rails-not-requested','context-changed']);
  function railsTransitionState(value,fromPage=false){
    const out={};
    for(const key of RAILS_TRANSITION_FLAGS){
      const v=fromPage&&key==='railsSelected'?read(read(value,'tools'),'rails'):read(value,fromPage&&key==='menuOpen'?'railsMenuOpen':key);
      if(typeof v==='boolean')out[key]=v;
    }
    for(const [key,limits] of Object.entries(RAILS_TRANSITION_NUMBERS)){
      const v=read(value,key);if(Number.isInteger(v)&&v>=limits[0]&&v<=limits[1])out[key]=v;
    }
    return out;
  }
  function railsTransitionReason(s){
    // Describes page-observed context only, never why a native guard rejected.
    return s.railsSelected===false?'selection-off':s.supported===false?'build-unavailable':s.ready===false?'state-unavailable':s.hidden===true?'tab-hidden':s.focused===false?'window-unfocused':s.menuOpen===true?'game-menu':s.network===true&&s.onlineAIAllowed===false?'network-permission':s.railsWanted===false?'mode-ineligible':s.safe===false?'not-driving':s.railsSuspended===true?(s.railsRecoveryTrips>=2?'recovery-limit':'recovery-release'):s.handbackPending===true?'handback-pending':s.railsOn===true?'simplified-physics-observed':s.railsRequested===true&&s.aiOwned===true&&s.aiActive===true&&s.physicsKind===1?'owned-full-physics-observed':s.railsRequested===true&&(s.aiOwned===false||s.aiActive===false)?'ownership-pending':s.railsWanted===true&&s.railsRequested===false?'rails-not-requested':'context-changed';
  }
  function cleanRailsTransition(value){
    if(read(value,'source')!=='page-observation'||!RAILS_TRANSITION_REASONS.has(read(value,'reason')))return null;
    const previous=railsTransitionState(read(value,'previous')),current=railsTransitionState(read(value,'current'));
    if(!Object.keys(previous).length||!Object.keys(current).length)return null;
    return {source:'page-observation',reason:read(value,'reason'),previous,current};
  }
  function errorInfo(error, stack) {
    const message = str(typeof error === 'string' ? error : read(error,'message'));
    const name = str(read(error,'name'));
    const text = `${name} ${message}`.toLowerCase();
    const errorKind = /out of bounds|bounds check|outside.*memory/.test(text) ? 'memory-bounds'
      : /unreachable/.test(text) ? 'unreachable'
      : /indirect call|signature mismatch|null function|table index/.test(text) ? 'indirect-call'
      : /divide by zero|integer overflow/.test(text) ? 'integer-divide'
      : /invalid conversion/.test(text) ? 'invalid-conversion'
      : /call stack|stack overflow/.test(text) ? 'stack-overflow'
      : /out of memory|allocation failed|memory allocation/.test(text) ? 'out-of-memory'
      : /typeerror/.test(text) ? 'type-error'
      : /referenceerror/.test(text) ? 'reference-error'
      : /syntaxerror/.test(text) ? 'syntax-error' : 'other';
    const source = str(stack === undefined ? read(error,'stack') : stack);
    // Keep only numeric wasm locations and known local source basenames/line numbers.
    // Never retain error text, URLs, arguments, file paths, arbitrary function names or query strings.
    const wasmFrames = [...source.matchAll(/wasm-function\[(\d{1,7})\]:(0x[0-9a-f]{1,12}|\d{1,12})(?![\da-f])/gi)].slice(0,12).map(m=>`wasm-function[${m[1]}]:${m[2]}`);
    const jsFrames = [...source.matchAll(/(?:^|[/\\\s(])((?:page|ai|core|diagnostics|current-profile|latest-profile|signatures|signature-profile|signature-profile-latest|dyno|dyno-core|dyno-full|dyno-evaluator|dyno-native|walls|cars|game-worker)\.js):(\d{1,7}):(\d{1,7})(?!\d)/g)].slice(0,8).map(m=>`${m[1]}:${m[2]}:${m[3]}`);
    return {errorKind,wasmFrames,jsFrames};
  }
  function sanitize(value) {
    const out = fields(value,FLAGS,NUMBERS);
    const railsEvent=cleanRailsTransition(read(value,'railsTransition'));if(railsEvent)out.railsTransition=railsEvent;
    for(const key of ['autonomyWaypointIndex','autonomyWaypointCount','autonomyCompletedTrips'])if(!Number.isInteger(read(value,key)))delete out[key];
    for(const key of ['ecuScopeHits','ecuActions','ecuClicks'])if(!Number.isInteger(read(value,key)))delete out[key];
    for(const [key,allowed] of Object.entries(TRACE_ENUMS))if(allowed.includes(read(value,key)))out[key]=read(value,key);
    for(const key of ['autonomySelectedCount','autonomyLocationCount','autonomyOfferCount'])if(!Number.isInteger(read(value,key)))delete out[key];
    for(const key of ['producerFailureCode','producerStage','forwardPlanReasonCode','nativePaceHits','forwardPlanConstraints','forwardPlanKnots','pacedAckRejectCode','pacedNativeStage','nativeWheelContactMask'])if(!Number.isInteger(read(value,key)))delete out[key];

/* Session-only reductions of the owned adaptive driver's pace request.
 * Distances are observations from the existing wall/car reader. They are not
 * a road centerline, a physical speed limit, or proof of complete coverage. */
(function(root){
  'use strict';
  const finite=(n,lo,hi)=>typeof n==='number'&&Number.isFinite(n)&&n>=lo&&n<=hi;
  function clearanceEnvelope({hazards,speedMps,brakingMps2=4,reactionSeconds=.6,marginM=8}={}){
    if(!finite(speedMps,0,500)||!finite(brakingMps2,.5,12)||!finite(reactionSeconds,0,2)||!finite(marginM,0,30))return {available:false};
    if(!hazards||!Array.isArray(hazards.cars)||hazards.cars.length>96)return {available:false};
    let distance=null,source=null;
    const accept=(d,s)=>{if(finite(d,0,150)&&(distance===null||d<distance)){distance=d;source=s;}};
    if(hazards.barrierAhead!==null&&hazards.barrierAhead!==undefined)accept(hazards.barrierAhead,'barrier');
    for(const car of hazards.cars)if(car&&finite(car.side,-2.5,2.5))accept(car.ahead,'vehicle');
    // No intersection gives no permission to accelerate: the reader's scan
    // is partial and can miss road curvature, height, shapes and moving cars.
    if(distance===null)return {available:true,observed:false};
    const availableM=Math.max(0,distance-marginM-speedMps*reactionSeconds);
    return {available:true,observed:true,source,distanceM:distance,targetMps:Math.sqrt(2*brakingMps2*availableM)};
  }
  class Pacing {
    constructor(){this.reset();}
    reset(){this.key=null;this.at=null;this.timingReady=false;this.pace=1;}

      const city=nativePaceSelected===true&&nativeFallback!==true;
      if(!finite(ceiling,city ? .75 : 1,city ? 3 : 2)||typeof identity!=='string'||!identity||identity.length>256){this.reset();return {active:false,state:'invalid',pace:1};}

      const continuous=sameOwner&&this.timingReady&&validTime&&this.at!==null&&now>=this.at&&now-this.at<=500;
      const timingState=!validTime?'invalid':!sameOwner?'initial':this.at!==null&&now<this.at?'rollback':continuous?'continuous':'gap';
      const sampleGapMs=sameOwner&&validTime&&this.at!==null&&now>=this.at?now-this.at:null;
      if(!sameOwner){this.pace=city?ceiling:1;this.key=identity;this.at=null;this.timingReady=false;}
      // A timing interruption discards race boost and earns no recovery. City
      // keeps its selected ceiling and any existing same-owner slowdown.
      else if(!continuous)this.pace=Math.min(this.pace,city?ceiling:1);

      // those counters remain zero while a 2x request otherwise stays active.
      const currentCorners=currentRoute&&finite(evidence.cornerPlannerCorners,1,5)&&Number.isInteger(evidence.cornerPlannerUsable)&&evidence.cornerPlannerUsable>0&&evidence.cornerPlannerUsable<=evidence.cornerPlannerCorners&&finite(evidence.cornerApplied,0,1)&&evidence.cornerHits>0&&evidence.brakingHits>0;
      // Road-race fallback keeps the user's selected native pace. Missing
      // optional corner records are not a slower speed limit. The existing
      // native driver still handles its route, braking and corner compensation;
      // partial heading-ray observations remain diagnostics, not an additional
      // uncalibrated physical speed controller. City slowing uses its own policy.
      if(nativeFallback===true){
        this.key=identity;this.at=null;this.timingReady=false;this.pace=ceiling;
        return {active:true,state:currentCorners?'native-route':'native-fallback',pace:ceiling,ceiling,currentCorners,clearance:clearanceEnvelope({hazards,speedMps,brakingMps2})};
      }
      // In city mode the ceiling is the user's existing native pace choice.
      // An empty partial scan does not create a new pace choice or route proof.
      let target=city?ceiling:currentCorners?ceiling:1,state=city?'selected-native':currentCorners?'native-route':'coverage-unknown';
      const clearance=clearanceEnvelope({hazards,speedMps,brakingMps2});
      if(clearance.observed&&speedMps>1&&clearance.targetMps<speedMps){
        // Convert the observed overspeed into an absolute pace request. Using
        // the prior reduced request here compounds the same observation every
        // page tick, before the physical car has had time to respond.
        const reduction=Math.min(target,Math.max(.75,(city?ceiling:Math.min(1,target))*clearance.targetMps/speedMps));
        if(reduction<target){target=reduction;state='clearance-limited';}
      }
      // Reduce immediately; city pace regains 0.35x/s toward the user's choice,
      // while the existing race planner retains 0.10x/s. A delayed timer or
      // replacement owner cannot jump straight back to the selected ceiling.
      this.pace=Math.max(.75,Math.min(target,this.pace+(city ? .35 : .1)*dt));
      // Invalid/backwards samples earn no recovery time. Keep the high-water
      // timestamp so clock rollback cannot credit the same interval twice;
      // the first fresh sample after an interruption only reestablishes time.
      if(validTime&&(this.at===null||now>=this.at)){this.at=now;this.timingReady=true;}
      else this.timingReady=false;
      return {active:true,state,pace:Math.round(this.pace*100)/100,ceiling,currentCorners,clearance,...(city?{timingState,sampleGapMs}:{})};
    }
  }
  const api=Object.freeze({Pacing,clearanceEnvelope});

 * acquire({signal}) -> {lease, setup, allowedOffsets} captures all setup bytes on
 * the game thread, installed-part eligibility, car/mode/generation and screen.

 'native-policy':'Waiting for the current native tuning policy to initialize.',
 'native-policy-initialization':'Load settings to initialize the game’s native tuning policy for this solo preset.',
 'screen-pointer':'Waiting for the Performance Tuning screen data.',
 'screen-main':'Return to the solo Performance Tuning main screen.',
 'memory-unavailable':'Tuning data is unavailable. Reload the game before retrying.'
});
const readinessStates=Object.freeze(Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(readinessLabels).map(([code,message])=>[code,Object.freeze({ready:code==='ready',code,message})])));
const inspectReasons=Object.freeze({'Unsupported game revision':'revision-unsupported','Dyno memory unavailable':'dyno-memory','Open Performance Tuning / Dyno':'tuning-context','Unrecognized tuning setup':'setup-invalid','Dyno changed while reading':'snapshot-changed'});
const errors={1:'Cancelled before applying a tune',2:'Open the solo Performance Tuning main screen with one local player',3:'Car, mode, installed parts or tuning changed. Find a new tune first',4:'Unsupported tuning request',5:'A selected tuning setting is locked',6:'Native dyno calculation returned an invalid result',8:'Full tuner snapshot layout is unsupported; no setup changes were made'};
// Fixed native guard IDs only. Never interpolate addresses or arbitrary game text.
const snapshotGuards=Object.freeze({
 1:'snapshot buffer bounds or alignment',2:'snapshot buffer signature',3:'snapshot protocol version',4:'snapshot buffer capacity',5:'snapshot buffer ownership',
 10:'tuning screen pointer',11:'preset record pointer',12:'active setup pointer',13:'local player pointer',14:'local car pointer',15:'car data pointer',
 20:'car data is not in a supported active ride',21:'car data overlaps preset records',22:'car data overlaps runtime state',23:'car data overlaps the car object',24:'car data overlaps the player object',
 30:'tuning rule count',31:'parts catalog count',32:'performance-curve sample count',
 40:'game image bounds',41:'car data bounds',42:'stock car data bounds',43:'tuning rule bounds',44:'parts catalog bounds',45:'performance-curve data bounds',
 50:'overlapping snapshot sources',60:'performance curve overlaps installed parts',70:'parts catalog child count',71:'parts lookup outside the captured catalog',72:'parts lookup alignment',73:'parts lookup references a missing child',74:'parts lookup selector mismatch',75:'native tuning policy is not initialized'
});
function rejection(status,guard,observed){
 const known=Object.hasOwn(snapshotGuards,guard),code=known?guard:0;
 let message=errors[status]||'Tuning request rejected';
 if(status===8&&known){
  const count=[30,31,32,70].includes(code)?` (${observed})`:'';
  message=`Tuner snapshot stopped [S${code}]: ${snapshotGuards[code]}${count}. No setup changes were made. ${code<=5?'Reload the game before retrying.':'Export crash log after this error.'}`;
 }
 const error=Error(message);error.dynoStatus=status;
 if(status===8){error.dynoGuard=code;if(known&&[30,31,32,50,70].includes(code))error.dynoObserved=observed;}
 return error;
}
const eq=(a,b)=>a.length===b.length&&a.every((x,i)=>x===b[i]);

 canUse(){return this.readiness().ready;}
 canCapture(){const state=this.captureReadiness();return state.ready||state.code==='native-policy-initialization';}
 captureContext(){
  if(this.busy||!this.canCapture()||this.applied)return null;
  if(this.canUse())return this.syncContext();
  // An unresolved native policy never revives an earlier private draft/lease.
  // The native capture must establish a fresh policy lease before editing.
  const current=Core.inspect(this.memory,this.revision);if(!current.available)return null;
  this.contexts.clear();this.context=null;this.outcome=null;this.lease=null;this.editor=null;
  return {key:`${current.record}:${current.tuned}:${current.kind}`,record:current.record,tuned:current.tuned,kind:current.kind,changed:true,initializingPolicy:true};
 }
 // Keep search/restore ownership separate for each native car and tuning mode.
 // This only changes UI state. Native command guards still authorize every write.
 syncContext(){
  if(this.busy||!this.canUse())return null;
  const current=Core.inspect(this.memory,this.revision);if(!current.available)return null;
  const key=`${current.record}:${current.tuned}:${current.kind}`,changed=this.context?.key!==key;
  if(changed){
   if(this.context?.record===current.record&&this.context?.tuned===current.tuned)this.contexts.set(this.context.key,{outcome:this.outcome,applied:this.applied,lease:this.lease,editor:this.editor});
   else this.contexts.clear(); // Never revive a lease across replacement car/ride objects.
   const saved=this.contexts.get(key);
   this.outcome=saved?.outcome||null;this.applied=saved?.applied||null;this.lease=saved?.lease||null;this.editor=saved?.editor||null;
   this.context={key,record:current.record,tuned:current.tuned,kind:current.kind};
  }
  const owned=this.applied||this.outcome||this.editor;let invalidated=false;
  if(owned){
   const lease=owned.lease,expected=this.applied?owned.current:owned.baseline,v=this.view();
   const parts=lease?.parts,valid=parts>=0x10000&&parts+148<=Math.min(v.byteLength,0x28000000);
   if(!lease||['record','tuned','kind'].some(k=>lease[k]!==current[k])||!eq(current.setup,expected)||!valid||v.getUint32(current.tuned+8,true)!==parts||!eq(new Uint8Array(v.buffer,parts,148),lease.partBytes)||this.revision==='bdc9cbc2'&&(!lease.nativePolicy||lease.nativePolicy.magic!==826495054||![0,1].includes(lease.nativePolicy.cache)||lease.nativePolicy.online!==0||v.getUint32(673810672,true)!==lease.nativePolicy.cache||v.getUint32(704975480,true)!==lease.nativePolicy.online)||this.revision==='b1efa173'&&(!lease.nativePolicy||lease.nativePolicy.magic!==826495054||![0,1].includes(lease.nativePolicy.cache)||lease.nativePolicy.online!==0||v.getUint32(673812320,true)!==lease.nativePolicy.cache||v.getUint32(705706016,true)!==lease.nativePolicy.online)||this.revision==='ed8d3359'&&(!lease.nativePolicy||lease.nativePolicy.magic!==826495054||![0,1].includes(lease.nativePolicy.cache)||lease.nativePolicy.online!==0||v.getUint32(673813312,true)!==lease.nativePolicy.cache||v.getUint32(704979224,true)!==lease.nativePolicy.online)||this.revision==='102c8d92'&&(!lease.nativePolicy||lease.nativePolicy.magic!==826495054||![0,1].includes(lease.nativePolicy.cache)||lease.nativePolicy.online!==0||v.getUint32(673813984,true)!==lease.nativePolicy.cache||v.getUint32(704980184,true)!==lease.nativePolicy.online)){
    // Manual edits/part changes invalidate restoration, never overwrite them.
    this.outcome=null;this.applied=null;this.lease=null;this.editor=null;this.contexts.delete(key);invalidated=true;
   }

 }
 setEnabled(value){this.enabled=!!value;if(!this.enabled)this.cancel();}

 allocate(){
  if(this.pb)return this.pb;
  const known=allocations.get(this.memory);
  if(known){if(known.module!==this.module)throw Error('Game memory was reused by another module. Reload before tuning.');this.pb=known.pb;return this.pb;}

 }
 async acquire({signal}={}){
  if(!this.prepared)throw Error('Full tuner evaluator was not prepared. Reload the supported game.');
  if(!this.evaluator)this.evaluator=await Evaluator.create(await this.prepared);
  const x=await this.request(16,{signal}),expected=this.searchContext;
  if(expected&&['record','tuned','kind'].some(k=>x.lease[k]!==expected[k]))throw Error('Car or race mode changed. Load the selected mode again.');
  const permissions=this.evaluator.load(x.snapshot);this.lease={...x.lease,baseline:x.setup,snapshot:x.snapshot};
  const measured=await this.evaluator.evaluate(x.setup,{signal});
  return {...x,...permissions,result:measured.result,lease:this.lease};
 }
 async evaluate({lease,setup,signal}){
  if(lease!==this.lease)throw Error('Expired tuning baseline');
  this.evaluator.load(lease.snapshot);return this.evaluator.evaluate(setup,{signal});
 }
 async release({lease}){if(this.pending)try{await this.pending;}catch{};if(this.failed)return {restored:false,reason:'game acknowledgement timed out'};return {restored:true};}
 async find({goal='peakPower',onProgress=()=>{}}={}){
  if(this.busy)throw Error('Tuner is already busy');if(!['peakPower','peakTorque','acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(goal))throw Error('Unsupported tuning goal');
  const context=this.syncContext();if(!context)throw Error(errors[2]);
  if(context.invalidated)throw Error('Car, installed parts or tuning changed. Load the selected mode again.');
  if(this.applied)throw Error('Restore the previous tune before searching again');
  const editor=this.editor;
  this.busy=true;this.outcome=null;this.abortController=new AbortController();this.searchContext={record:context.record,tuned:context.tuned,kind:context.kind};
  try{
   const signal=this.abortController.signal,pre=await this.acquire({signal});
   // A draft belongs to its exact original live baseline, not merely this mode.
   // Fresh frame capture must also preserve the selected visit and stored presets.
   if(editor){
    const old=editor.lease,fresh=pre.lease;
    if(!old||['record','tuned','kind','parts','ride'].some(k=>old[k]!==fresh[k])||!eq(editor.baseline,pre.setup)||!eq(old.partBytes,fresh.partBytes)||!eq(old.recordBytes,fresh.recordBytes)||!eq(old.visitBytes,fresh.visitBytes))throw Error('Draft baseline changed. Load the selected mode again.');
   }
   const curveOffsets=pre.allowedOffsets.filter(n=>n>=23||(['acceleration60','acceleration100','topSpeed'].includes(goal)&&n>=9&&n<=15));
   if(!curveOffsets.length)throw Error('No tuning fields for this goal are unlocked by the installed parts');
   const requested=Core.setupCopy(editor?editor.draft:pre.setup),allowed=new Set(pre.allowedOffsets);
   for(let i=0;i<41;i++)if(requested[i]!==pre.setup[i]&&!allowed.has(i))throw Error('This draft setting is now locked');
   // Accept native coupling in private memory before selecting automatic fields.
   // Search's own scope check keeps every other accepted manual field fixed.
   const seed=editor?await this.evaluate({lease:pre.lease,setup:requested,signal}):{setup:pre.setup,result:pre.result};
   const seedSetup=Core.setupCopy(seed.setup);
   const adapter={acquire:async()=>({...pre,setup:Core.setupCopy(seedSetup),result:{...seed.result}}),evaluate:args=>this.evaluate(args),release:args=>this.release(args)};
   const search=new Core.Search(adapter);
   const outcome=await search.run({goal,offsets:curveOffsets,budget:48,steps:[40,20,10],signal,onProgress});
   const baseline=Core.setupCopy(pre.setup),baselineResult={...pre.result},changes=Core.setupDiff(baseline,outcome.best,outcome.bestRequest);
   this.outcome={...outcome,type:'search',lease:pre.lease,baseline,baselineResult,seed:seedSetup,seedRequest:requested,seedResult:{...seed.result},improvedFromSeed:outcome.improved,improved:Core.score(outcome.bestResult,goal)>Core.score(baselineResult,goal)+1e-5,changes,changed:changes.some(change=>change.before!==change.after)};
   return this.outcome;
  }finally{this.searchContext=null;this.abortController=null;this.busy=false;this.cancel();}
 }
 // Manual drafts and every native trial stay in private memory. Live setup
 // writes occur only through the bounded selected-preset Stage/Restore protocol.
 async loadSetup(){
  if(this.busy)throw Error('Tuner is already busy');
  if(this.applied)throw Error('Restore the previous tune before loading an editable setup');
  const context=this.captureContext();if(!context)throw Error(errors[2]);
  this.busy=true;this.outcome=null;this.editor=null;this.abortController=new AbortController();
  this.searchContext={record:context.record,tuned:context.tuned,kind:context.kind};
  try{
   const loaded=await this.acquire({signal:this.abortController.signal});
   if(this.abortController.signal.aborted)throw Object.assign(Error('Tuning cancelled'),{name:'AbortError'});
   if(context.initializingPolicy){
    if(!this.canUse()||['record','tuned','kind'].some(key=>loaded.lease[key]!==context[key]))throw Error('Native tuning policy or selected preset changed during capture');
    this.context={key:context.key,record:context.record,tuned:context.tuned,kind:context.kind};
   }
   this.editor={lease:this.lease,baseline:Core.setupCopy(loaded.setup),draft:Core.setupCopy(loaded.setup),allowedOffsets:[...loaded.allowedOffsets],unlockedOffsets:[...loaded.unlockedOffsets],baselineResult:{...loaded.result}};
   return this.editor;
  }finally{this.searchContext=null;this.abortController=null;this.busy=false;this.cancel();}
 }
 setDraft(offset,value){
  if(this.busy)throw Error('Tuner is already busy');
  if(!this.enabled||!this.syncContext()||!this.editor||this.applied)throw Error('Load settings for the selected car and mode first');
  if(!this.editor.allowedOffsets.includes(offset))throw Error('This setting is locked');
  if(!Number.isInteger(value)||value<0||value>200)throw Error('Invalid tuning value');
  this.editor.draft[offset]=value;this.outcome=null;
 }
 resetDraft(){
  if(this.busy||!this.enabled||!this.syncContext()||!this.editor||this.applied)throw Error('Load settings for the selected car and mode first');
  this.editor.draft=Core.setupCopy(this.editor.baseline);this.outcome=null;
 }
 async preview(){
  if(this.busy)throw Error('Tuner is already busy');
  if(!this.syncContext()||!this.editor||this.applied)throw Error('Load settings for the selected car and mode first');
  const editor=this.editor,requested=Core.setupCopy(editor.draft),allowed=new Set(editor.allowedOffsets);
  for(let i=0;i<41;i++)if(requested[i]!==editor.baseline[i]&&!allowed.has(i))throw Error('This setting is locked');
  this.busy=true;this.outcome=null;this.abortController=new AbortController();let result;
  try{
   this.lease=editor.lease;result=await this.evaluate({lease:editor.lease,setup:requested,signal:this.abortController.signal});
